CustomField.description: Slack Channel(s) that should be notified on L3 escalations (comma separated)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The L3 Slack Channel Id is used for Case Escalations. For example, when a L2 Escalation for this team is raised this channel (or channels) will receive a slack message. To specify a single channel, simply type in the Slack channel Id, i.e. GCEBYKZ24, or specify multiple channels via comma separated values, i.e. GCEBYKZ24,CCC66LTRT. You can identify a Slack Channel Id by right clicking a Slack Channel in the Slack UI > Copy Link > and extracting the rightmost value.
CustomField.label: L3 Slack Channel Ids
